features.name: Batch immutable receipt candidate input reads per invocation
features.description: Reduce deterministic real Git process counts inside _receipt_candidate using existing blobs while retaining all current receipt predicates and fresh materialized observations.

acceptance_requirements.real-git-count-reduction: Same valid synthetic multi-path readset: at least 50% fewer actual immutable-input Git child processes than unchanged _entry_blob oracle; all counted operations execute real Git, identical bytes/modes and positive receipt result; no timing threshold.
acceptance_requirements.semantic-equivalence: Isolated valid/reject controls for exact commit/tree/ancestor/origin, missing/nonblob/mode/digest, canonical ownership and environment; preserve actual intended rejection categories, not setup failures.
acceptance_requirements.fresh-mutations: Repeat calls around physical bytes/mode/type/symlink changes, owned/unowned record mutations, environment changes and restoration; no stale cross-call/cross-root cache; integrated hardlink rejection remains covered at its existing boundary.
acceptance_requirements.literal-paths-and-modes: Independent synthetic paths with spaces, tabs/newlines, non-ASCII and leading dashes when valid under existing relative_path; exact per-path identity/mode/type, no pathspec alias or directory/submodule substitution.
acceptance_requirements.existing-bank: All original 48 ordered cases and 166 fixture checks retained; strengthen coverage if needed and record actual resulting counts honestly.
acceptance_requirements.delivery: All currently required exact-head capable-CI jobs, independent Mode B/fresh QA/one additional adversarial check, Root capture, merge and main CI; historical 123 proof is not current 133 proof.

features.product_boundary: Only _receipt_candidate implementation changes; existing blobs and _entry_blob retain behavior. Use the existing frozen capture driver by reference; no new orchestration subsystem.

external_prerequisites.planning_and_contract_reviews: May overlap frozen PR 104 CI; no implementation before Root activation/budget disposition and both independent pre-code gates.
external_prerequisites.implementation: PR 104 normally merged after all six required checks; independent source work may overlap its main CI.
external_prerequisites.integration: Old PR 104 main CI all five success before new maintenance integration/merge. Existing 129–132/020 and 124–125/019 unchanged; 133 is not their prerequisite.
